title: Review a newly added "queued messages" panel feature in the aura-harness Rust workspace (Cursor-style panel above the c…
summary: I found 3 high, 5 medium and 6 low-severity problems. The feature works on the happy path, but there are real bugs in keyboard focus, id handling and edit edge cases. Both commands you asked for pass: the tests (19 in aura-app, 28 in aura-ui-terminal) and clippy with `-D warnings` on all four crates.
